heroSubtitle: Two dedicated tools working in perfect unison. Capture physical geometry in real-world spaces with our mobile app, and apply pro-grade textures, colors, and designs on your desktop device.

mobile.description: Turn a real sneaker into a 3D model. Record a 360° video around the shoe with your phone; KIRI Engine reconstructs the 3D model, you preview it on the phone and save it as a project.
mobile.spec1: 3D reconstruction from video with KIRI Engine
mobile.spec2: Video uploads straight to secure cloud storage
mobile.spec3: Preview the 3D model right on your phone
mobile.spec4: Save as a project and continue on the web and KusStudio Desktop
mobile.androidMeta: Android 7.0 or later • officially signed APK
mobile.iosComingSoon: KusShoes for iOS is coming soon. For now, please use an Android phone.
mobile.noApkYet: The first APK is being prepared. Please check back soon.
mobile.apkInstallHint: Open the downloaded APK to install. If Android asks, allow installing apps from your browser.

desktop.description: Customise shoes in 3D on your computer: open a scan from your web project, crop the model, add stickers and text, preview and export the 3D file.
desktop.spec2: Layered stickers and text on the shoe
desktop.spec3: 3D model export as GLB and OBJ
desktop.spec4: Open a project from the web in one click
desktop.windowsMeta: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) • The 3D renderer (about 400 MB) downloads on first launch
desktop.macComingSoon: KusShoes Editor for macOS is coming soon. For now, please use a Windows PC.
desktop.noInstallerYet: The first Windows installer is being prepared. Please check back soon.
desktop.smartScreenHint: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info → Run anyway.

workflow.title: How They Sync
workflow.desc: Scan a sneaker with the <b1>KusShoes App</b1>: the video uploads to the cloud, KIRI Engine builds the 3D model and you save it as a project. The project appears right away in your web dashboard; click “Open in KusStudio” to keep editing it in <b2>KusStudio Desktop</b2>.
